response.sql: SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS average_gbsize_per_minute FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND scans.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY sites.riskeval
